approved_by: user 2026-10-05 ('Approve all three ... make it symmetric and fair'), with the clarifications applied below
freeze_rule: Nothing in this file changes after freezing; changes go in an amendment. Smoke on 999xxxxx only; no state is collected on the confirmatory block before this file is committed.
paper_question: Does changing only the latent strategy input causally steer the shared policy toward the corresponding teacher? (independent of BEHAVIOR_SIGNATURES_2V2_V1 and REPLICATION_2V2_DUAL_BRANCH_V1; results are not combined)
classification: Causal intervention on the strategy input of the shared student. Read-only; no training.
symmetry: The two contrasts are mirror images (C_A for teacher A, C_B for teacher B), use the same distance, the same states and the same rule; probe states come from both z values on both poles in equal numbers.

subject.intervention: on the IDENTICAL observation dict (roles attached as in eval_suite_sharing_crossover), student logits are computed twice via CustomPPOInferencePolicy.get_distribution(obs, z_idx=...): z_idx = 0 (A) and z_idx = 1 (B). Only z differs.

teachers.teacher_distribution: rl/teacher_distillation.dual_branch_composite_logits (mode dual_branch_role_gated): CLOSEST_DEFENDS roles in obs['roles'] select the DEFEND model's logits or the exported ATTACK branch's logits per agent. This is the exact teacher the Stage-4 distillation loss (distillation_loss) used, so the reference is the object the student was distilled toward

distance_frozen.convention: the distillation convention of rl/teacher_distillation.py: forward KL(teacher || student) per action head (kl_per_head on head_logits, i.e. the legality-masked distributions), summed over heads, at decision-boundary agents only (decision_mask_from_core, as the Stage-4 collector records it)
distance_frozen.notation: d(T, z) = KL(T || pi_student(. | o, r, z)) on one agent-state

state_collection.rollouts: the student itself, natural episodes, z in {A, B} x pole in {A, B}, 64 seeds each (256 episodes); every decision-boundary agent-state is a probe
state_collection.why_both_z: probe states come from both strategies' own visitation so neither z is favoured by the state distribution

primary_frozen.C_A: d(T_A, z=B) - d(T_A, z=A): positive = z=A puts the student closer to teacher A than z=B does
primary_frozen.C_B: d(T_B, z=A) - d(T_B, z=B): positive = z=B puts the student closer to teacher B than z=A does
primary_frozen.statistical_unit: THE PROBE SEED: each contrast is averaged over all decision-boundary agent-states from that seed's four episodes, giving one value per seed (n = 64); states, agents and ticks are never independent samples
primary_frozen.decision_rule: z causally steers the shared policy toward the corresponding teacher when BOTH C_A and C_B have 95% lower bounds > 0 (intersection-union: both must hold, so no further multiplicity correction)

secondary_descriptive.S1_divergence: Jensen-Shannon divergence between pi(.|o,r,z=A) and pi(.|o,r,z=B) (jsd_per_head, summed over heads), seed-level mean with 95% interval
secondary_descriptive.S2_argmax_flip: fraction of decision-boundary agent-states where the argmax joint action differs between z=A and z=B; NOT required to be non-zero, since z can change the distribution without changing its top action
secondary_descriptive.S3_teacher_scale: KL(T_A || T_B) and KL(T_B || T_A) on the same states, to scale C_A and C_B
secondary_descriptive.breakdown: all primary and secondary quantities also per (collection z, pole) cell and per role (ATTACK / DEFEND), descriptive

trajectory_level: trajectory consequences of forcing z come from BEHAVIOR_SIGNATURES_2V2_V1 (its Fully Shared+z+r arm); not duplicated here
launch: after the 4v4 Stage-4 chain finishes (user ordering)
